node.title: Budget-three equal-multifiber quotient constructions are Vandermonde-excluded
node.statement: If B_i is a union of s full fibers of one monomial map X^m and A_i=B_i/(X-r_i) deletes one distinct root, then the top m coefficients of A_i are the geometric vector (1,r_i,...,r_i^(m-1)). Any t<=m such locators are Vandermonde-independent. Hence all four cycle chambers are incompatible with direct equal-multifiber quotient completions for m>=4, and both path chambers are incompatible for m>=3. At d=2^39 this excludes every power-of-two quotient-fiber size m>=4 in those six chambers; small-fiber, mixed-map, partial-fiber, primitive, and the other seven chamber residuals remain open.
